WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS benchmark
  FROM per_order
), first_filtered AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_remain, p.avg_remain - b.benchmark AS excess_first
  FROM per_order p
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b
  WHERE p.avg_remain > b.benchmark
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS benchmark
  FROM first_filtered
), remaining AS (
  SELECT f.avg_remain, f.excess_first, f.avg_remain - b.benchmark AS excess_second
  FROM first_filtered f
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b
  WHERE f.avg_remain > b.benchmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS average_remaining_order_average,
       AVG(excess_first) AS average_excess_over_first_benchmark,
       AVG(excess_second) AS average_excess_over_second_benchmark
FROM remaining;
